sections.title: Ready for Mealie 3.31
items: Export a whole cookbook as a PDF with cover page and table of contents – tap the PDF button in a cookbook (requires Mealie 3.31).
Cookbook descriptions now show Markdown formatting such as bold text, lists and links.
Recipe actions support the new temporary share link placeholder, so other services can open private recipes too.

sections.title: More filters
items: Cookbooks and meal plan rules can now also filter by label, rating, last made, date created and date updated.
The recipe finder can filter by date created and date updated.

sections.title: Fixes
items: The cook time is shown in the recipe list again.
A clear message appears when a file is too large for the server's upload limit.
